modalities.evidence: resting-state EEG data collected with the Biosemi ActiveTwo

output.population: 140 participants: 74 juvenile offenders and 66 juvenile non-offender controls; exclusion criteria were psychiatric treatment and dental/orthodontic appliances.
output.summary: Resting-state EEG recorded with a Biosemi ActiveTwo system from juvenile offenders and juvenile non-offender controls recruited in Barranquilla, with demographic and group assignment files included.
